name: Powerdyne International, Inc.
summary: Powerdyne International, Inc., operating through its various subsidiaries, is primarily engaged in the manufacturing and distribution of motors. The company's core expertise lies in designing and custom-building industrial servomotors, offering both brushed and brushless technological solutions. In addition to its motor business, Powerdyne also provides bespoke framing services. Its diverse clientele for these services includes local educational establishments (schools and colleges), art organizations (guilds, individual artists, art galleries), interior designers, museums, photographers, and theaters. Powerdyne International, Inc. was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in North Reading, Massachusetts.
